detail: servo mg90-d, motor mg90-d, board dev-v006-2A-D, state servo-meter

The servo's motor and pot leads on the board, the board on the DPS, the adapter on the bus, the horn off and the rotor free. DMM on DC A, red probe in the A jack on the 22.000 A range, in series on the MOT_A side with its red lead toward MOT_A: MOT_A -> meter -> motor lead -> motor -> other lead -> MOT_B. Bluetooth on.
meter polarity: the forward spin reads +69.5 mA
resistance/meter: the fwd seat moved +12 counts, over 10
